name: e2e-platform-monorepo
description: Extensible end-to-end testing for CLI, HTTP, desktop, web and mobile applications

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/core run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/process run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/checks run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/native run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/terminal run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/playwright run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/agent-device run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/github run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/oauth run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/cpp run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.canary: node scripts/canary-changeset.ts && changeset version --snapshot canary && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/core run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/process run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/checks run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/native run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/terminal run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/playwright run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/agent-device run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/github run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/oauth run test && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/cpp run test
scripts.build:native: pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/core run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/process run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/checks run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/native run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/terminal run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/cpp run build
scripts.test:native: pnpm run build:native && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/process run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/checks run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/native run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/terminal run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-platform/cpp run test
scripts.check:local: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run docs:check
